notes.title: "The end" Update (Broken tape v1.08)
notes.content:
[b]Hello our dear players![/b] We are sooo back... We finally [b]fixed the bug with achievements[/b] for those of you who is crazy enough to completely beat the game, and made a lot of small great changes that [b]improve player's experience[/b]. Those changes mainly relate to the game's endings. Don't worry - we might've reworked the end of the game, but it's most certainly [b]not the end for us![/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- The endings now have a visual.
- Each ending appears only for the first time now, so you don't have to skip it every time you beat the game.
- The text in the data and endings now is more readable.
- Slightly reworked the ending dialogues, so now you have unlimited time to catch up with it.
- Free roam mode: after 100% completion of the game, tapes don't go away and always have an anomaly, so you can go get the missing achievements.
- Anomalies stats and records stats in the ending are now the same screen.[/i]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[i]- Now there are no problems with achievements.
- The tutorial tape doesn't miss the overlay now.
- The final ending appears the moment you get 100%.[/i]

notes.title: "For fuck's sake" Update (Broken Tape v1.07)
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! It's a been a while, wasn't it? After some time in a mental hospital our programmer has finally recovered enough to make a new update. Unlike AAA studios, we actually listen to our players, so one of the game's problems - weird tutorial that a lot of players missed - was fixed! Now new players will be able to understand what's happening in the game. [b]As for us, we still do not.[/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- We have made a new tutorial from scratch![/i]

[b]New lore details:[/b]
[i]- Now you can see the information about the tapes.[/i]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[i]- The intro text was reworked a bit.
- Additional wall in the empty warehouse was removed.
- Anomaly's information is no longer the same for both versions of the forklift anomaly.
- The description of the anomaly #4404 was fixed.[/i]

notes.title: "I hate game development" update (Broken Tape v1.06)
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! In this patch we fixed a lot of crucial things, including the hard lock that was preventing players from beating the game. This update took a lot of time and nerves from the developers, so [b]we hope you'll enjoy the game while we're searching for a psychotherapist for our programmer.[/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- Empty tapes appear with a twice as less chance now.
- Flickering lights in the Hotel are now more obvious.[/i]

[b]Technical improvements: [/b]
[i]- The game's size has been reduced by 450mb. Good diet![/i]

[b]Bug fixes (oh, boy, there's a lot):[/b]
[i]- Hard lock that was preventing players from beating the game was fixed. 
- Game's progress is no longer stuck at 33% in the main menu.
- Glass pieces in the Firetower tape are no longer able to throw you out of the location.
- Rock that breaks the glass now disappears when rewinded.
- When deleting the save, game's displayed progress associated with that save resets.
- Footstep sounds are no longer played when exiting the Fire Tower.
- Saved game's settings now load after restarting the game.
- The outcome after the anomaly is eliminated is no longer reset to “empty tape” if new rooms appear after rewinding the tape.
- The cave's clipping was fixed.[/i]

[b]Translation fixes:[/b]
[i]- Fixed the cause of death of the broken lights anomaly.
- The missing translations in the instructions have been translated.[/i]

notes.title: Yet another quality of life update (v1.05)
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! Yet one more time we update the quality of player's life. [b]Even your government isn't that productive as we are![/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- When choosing the save in the main menu, now it shows you the game progress
- Now you can choose, whether you want to see the list of all anomalies or only those you've already discovered
- New mouse sensitivity setting
- Now you can skip the "anomalies discovered" screen at the game's end
- We reworked the "Cul-de-Sac" anomaly[/i]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[i]- Wrong links were fixed[/i]

notes.title: The "Protocol" Update (v1.04)
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! This update brings the new protocol system to the game. [b]Yep, our game is getting better and better.[/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]We have updated the protocol tab! Now the game keep records of all of your interactions with the tape.
[*]Protocol's UI was reworked from scratch.
[*]The death screen now appears for longer time so you have enough time to read the death reason.
[*]The skip button in the death screen is faster now.[/i]
[/list]

[b]New lore details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]You can see the information about the anomaly class now.[/i]
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]The instruction text was fixed.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: The "Update" update (v1.03)
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! This update brings to the game the new in-game update system. [b]Yes, we have updated updates![/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- The update system in the data was completely reworked. Now it remembers, what have you read and not.
- Anomaly list's UI was slightly changed.[/i]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[i]- Now the skeleton can be rewinded even if you move it somewhere else.
- The falling box anomaly now works just fine.
- The Paris painting in the hotel is no longer missing if anomaly is present.
- Some of the anomaly detection zones were increased
- Garage door doesn't disappear when rewinded.
- VHS Player UI no longer messes up when spam clicking.
- Now all of the lights turn on after rewinding them in the office tape.[/i]

notes.title: Broken tape v1.02 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! We've fixed a few bugs and improved the player experience. [b]Making the game better is our obligatory![/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- We have improved the rewind system and made sure it's more clear now.
- We added a reminder to leave the tape in case if the new player is lost.[/i]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[i]- The text is no longer extends beyond the screen in certain cases.
- Some anomaly detection zones were extended.
- Step sounds are no longer played when the game is paused.[/i]

[b]Translation fixes:[/b]
[i]- The "Remotes left" text was not translated to other languages.[/i]

notes.title: First day patch
notes.content:
Hello our dear players! 
We've fixed a few bugs and improved the player experience. [b]The work has only just begun![/b]

[b]Player experience improvements:[/b]
[i]- New randomization system! The likelihood of player coming across locations without anomalies will now be more balanced.
- A tutorial reminder during the gameplay when player starts the first tape.[/i]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[i]- Tapes to longer jump in place when player toggles over them.
- Bigger remote area for a skeleton anomaly.
- The player can now remote the statue through gaps in the shelves.
- In the office, papers on the board will no longer clip into each other.
- Fixed TV screen fading when starting the tape.
- The information in Data about the hand in the box can no longer be shown as a 4/3 when fully completed.
- The information in Data about cereal box can now be properly open.
- Some of the information in Data is no longer mixed up.[/i]

[b]Translation fixes:[/b]
[i]- Doctor Xavier Byrne now appears as X. Byrne in the cutscenes.[/i]

notes.title: We are out!
notes.content:
After 2 months since the announcement, 2 months of waiting for you, and [i]even more months for us[/i] since the start of development we can finally say that [b]our first game is out!!! [/b]

[h1]So we are happy to present you -
BR0KEN TAPE.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042887/e926256ed56a2ca337f80de2ce76f1730f7d007d.png[/img]

Those months flew by in a blink of an eye, but we will always remember how much work we did during that time, and how much respect we gained for our little project as it evolved. And despite our ups and downs during development, we genuinely love what we've created and hope you can feel at least half the inspiration we put into it.

[b]Thank you for your patience and desire to play Broken Tape. Be afraid, pay attention, but most importantly have fun![/b]

I don't want to sound like a broken record ([i]haha, get it?[/i]), but we're a small indie studio of two people, so despite our best efforts, there may be bugs or typos in the game. If you find something, anything, or just want to chat with us about the game, write to us on [url=https://x.com/LotokINC]Twitter[/url] (X, whatever) or on our [url=https://discord.gg/A99BrXWpbN]Discord server[/url]. We will do your best to fix every found bug as soon as possible.
